entry.title: Douglas County Ballot Returns Reach 28.06% With One Week Until Election Day
entry.summary: Douglas County has received 25,098 ballots, bringing participation to 28.06% with one week until the November 3 election. Returns are slightly ahead of 2022 as officials remind voters about ballot deadlines and prepare to release election-night results.

entry.title: Fire Season Ends in Douglas District as Rain and Cooler Weather Return

entry.title: Fast-Moving Grass Fire Prompts Second-Alarm Response Near Roberts Creek Road
entry.summary: A fast-moving, wind-driven grass fire near Roberts Creek Road grew to an estimated 10 acres Sunday afternoon, prompting a second-alarm response as firefighters worked to protect nearby homes. Multiple fire agencies assisted Central Douglas Fire & Rescue.

entry.title: Roseburg Records Nearly Half an Inch of Rain Sunday as Wet, Cooler Weather Continues This Week

entry.title: Kimz Klozet in Green Up for Sale, Could Close Next Summer as Owner Plans to Retire
entry.summary: Kimz Klozet owner Kimberly Torres plans to close her Green boutique by August 2027 if it doesn't sell. Citing the demands of running two businesses and growing competition from online shopping, Torres hopes to semi-retire while continuing Kimz Formalz.

entry.title: Boom Truck Destroyed By Fire Along Highway 42 Near Camas Valley
entry.summary: A boom truck was destroyed by fire Saturday afternoon along Highway 42 near Camas Valley. Firefighters prevented the flames from spreading into nearby vegetation. No injuries were reported, and a fuel leak is believed to have caused the fire.
